Built for groups moving through the real world.
PeerMesh helps groups communicate, coordinate, and build shared awareness while moving together in the real world.

• Hiking
• Camping
• Cycling
• Outdoor events
• Team activities
• Weak connectivity
Nearby devices communicate directly over local wireless technologies.\n\nWhen internet is available, optional relay services can help synchronize data across longer distances.
PeerMesh brings together messages, maps, markers, routes, and observations into one shared understanding of what is happening around a group.
• No account required\n• End-to-end encrypted communication\n• Messages remain under your control
For support, feedback, or feature suggestions:
Designed for everyday local communication and resilience planning. Not a replacement for official emergency services.

Help shape PeerMesh Beta. Tell us what worked, what confused you, or what you\'d like to see next.
PeerMesh Beta is an early-access program. Beta users help shape the product by trying current capabilities and sending feedback while the product is still evolving.
During Beta, PeerMesh can enable current premium-style features for testing while keeping Free-level usage limits. Beta is not a paid plan and does not require purchase.
Your feedback helps us find bugs, improve usability, and decide which features should become part of future plans.
Feedback may include basic app and device information to help debug issues. It does not include your private messages, location, trails, or group content.
